description:
Bugle brings the news you follow into one timeline. Newspapers, blogs, Hacker News and podcasts run into a single list, the day's biggest stories first. It is a news app first, and an RSS and Atom reader too.

One story, every newsroom. The same story from several outlets is one row, with how left, center and right covered it. Blindspots shows what one side skipped, and Both Sides gives you the stories worth comparing.

Features:
- Add any site by pasting its address, or bring your feeds in with OPML
- Curated newsrooms, tech and Mac sites and ten cities' local desks, a tap away
- Stories open in full, even when a feed only sends a summary, with sharp pictures
- Hacker News stories come with the whole comment thread
- Podcasts on a shelf beside the headlines: 2x speed, queue, downloads, sleep timer
- The Briefing reads you the day's five biggest stories
- Translate any story on your device, in nineteen languages
- Save stories and read them offline, pictures included
- Widget, Siri, Spotlight and Share from Safari
- Three columns and keyboard shortcuts on iPad and Mac
- Light, dark and your own text size

No account needed, no ads and no tracking. An optional account syncs your feeds, saved stories, topics and mutes across your devices. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and in any browser at bugle.jaybulb.com.
promotionalText: All your news in one timeline: newspapers, blogs, Hacker News and podcasts, with how each side covered the story. Free, no account.
